title: Lovegobuy Spreadsheet Photo Evidence Index
content_angle: A four-page index each saved image by row, visible feature, identity boundary, and follow-up question. Its independent output remains useful without the project link and it makes no claim about current inventory, price, quality, eligibility, policy, or delivery outcomes.
difference_notes: This photo evidence index produces a distinct saved output, evidence field set, worked example, exception path, and decision vocabulary from earlier Lovegobuy assets.
